summary: Esquire Financial Holdings completed its merger with Signature Bancorporation effective August 1, 2026, pursuant to a March 11, 2026 agreement. Each Signature share was converted into 2.671 Esquire shares, with cash for fractional shares. Equity awards were assumed and converted by the exchange ratio. The transaction closed via a two-step merger with Merger Sub, followed by a bank-level merger into Esquire Bank. This is a completed acquisition, so the risk-arb angle is moot; focus shifts to post-merger integration and combined financial performance.
